record.paper_title: The Lieb-Thirring inequalities: recent results and open problems
record.original_question: For the Dirichlet Laplacian on a bounded planar domain, determine whether Pólya's conjectured semiclassical bound already holds for the special case of a disc in dimension d=2; equivalently, decide whether the associated eigenvalue inequality can hold with the semiclassical constant for that domain.

evidence.quote: In particular, it is still unknown whether the inequality holds with the semiclassical constant in the special case where Ω is a disc in d = 2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : |x| < 1\}$ be the open unit disc in the plane, and let $-\Delta_\Omega^D$ denote the Dirichlet Laplacian on $\Omega$, with eigenvalues $0 < \lambda_1 < \lambda_2 \le \lambda_3 \le \cdots \to \infty$ (counted with multiplicity). Let $N(\lambda) := \#\{k : \lambda_k < \lambda\}$ be the eigenvalue counting function. Pólya's conjecture asserts that for every bounded domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^d$,
$$N(\lambda) \le \frac{|\Omega|}{(2\pi)^d}\, \omega_d \, \lambda^{d/2} \qquad \text{for all } \lambda > 0,$$
where $\omega_d$ is the volume of the unit ball in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Equivalently, in dual form, this is the semiclassical bound
$$\sum_{k=1}^{n} \lambda_k \ge \frac{d}{d+2}\, \frac{(2\pi)^2}{(\omega_d |\Omega|)^{2/d}}\, n^{1+2/d}$$
on Riesz means of order $1$.

Determine whether Pólya's conjectured inequality $N(\lambda) \le \frac{|\Omega|}{4\pi}\lambda$ holds for all $\lambda > 0$ when $\Omega$ is the unit disc in $\mathbb{R}^2$.
artifact.status_search_result: Filonov, Levitin, Polterovich, and Sher (2023, Inventiones Math.) proved Pólya's conjecture for Euclidean balls in all dimensions for the Dirichlet Laplacian, settling the disc (d=2) case. The conjecture has been further extended to annuli (Filonov, J. London Math. Soc., 2026).

status_evidence.title: Pólya's conjecture for Euclidean balls
status_evidence.snippet: We prove Pólya's conjecture on the eigenvalues of the Dirichlet Laplacian for Euclidean balls in any dimension, in particular settling the disc case in d=2.
status_evidence.claim: Pólya's conjecture for the Dirichlet Laplacian on the disc (and on Euclidean balls of any dimension) is proved.

status_evidence.title: Pólya's conjecture for Euclidean balls — Inventiones mathematicae
status_evidence.snippet: Published proof of Pólya's conjecture for Euclidean balls including the planar disc.
status_evidence.claim: Peer-reviewed publication confirming the disc case is solved.

status_evidence.title: Pólya's conjecture for Dirichlet eigenvalues of annuli
status_evidence.snippet: Extends the proof for balls to annular planar domains.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent works build on the resolved disc case.
